verdict.rationale: Productboard exposes a broad REST API (feedback, features, teams, webhooks, dynamic schema) plus an MCP server letting AI agents create features, reprioritize initiatives, and access specs—covering many core workflows. However, there's no evidence of full UI parity (e.g., roadmap visualization, all settings/admin UI actions), and no public OpenAPI spec was found, suggesting some functionality may remain UI-only.
